tools.name: quickstart
tools.description: Compact capability manifest for clients: purpose, workflow, routing table, examples, vocabulary guard, scope caveats, next actions, and contact. A short, low-token summary of what this server does and what it returns.

tools.name: coverage
tools.description: What this server covers: deals and loans against the universe, the field inventory with full bound definitions, counterparty roles, current-only scope, and dual-sourced agreement stats (single-source reported separately). An OUT_OF_COVERAGE answer means the deal or field is outside this coverage; UN

tools.name: find_deals
tools.description: Search covered deals by id, trust name, CIK, alias, shelf, vintage or deal_ref. An EXACT query returns one dominant result. A fuzzy query returns a small ranked set with match reasons, periods and a suggested next call. Returns at most the requested number of matches.

tools.name: covered_deals
tools.description: List every deal this server can verify, with CIKs, aliases and filing periods. Returns the full covered set, which can be long.

tools.name: verify_loan_field
tools.description: Verify one loan-grain field of a CMBS loan against the SEC 10-D and ABS-EE filings. Values are TRUST-LEVEL (this trust's piece, not the whole loan). Always the CURRENT period; the receipt stamps its as-of. Pass claimed_value: you get CONFIRM / DENY / CONFLICT / UNVERIFIED plus an sf-receipt. No clai

tools.name: verify_deal_field
tools.description: Verify one pool-level field of a deal: the ABS-EE loan-tape rollup against the 10-D trustee's reported fact. These are COLLATERAL (loan-pool) balances and flows, NOT bond or certificate balances, and SCHEDULED and ACTUAL are different fields. No loan_id. Always the CURRENT period. Pass claimed_value

tools.name: verify_fund_holding_coupon
tools.description: Verify the NPORT cross-filer annualized coupon rate (annualized_rate) for one security identifier. Security-grain, N-source receipt: citations are peer NPORT-P filings by registrant CIK, dissenters included. CURRENT-ONLY (latest NPORT period exported). Ticker matches are not unique: set require_hard

tools.name: verify_building_size
tools.description: Verify issuance building size (Annex A vs ABS-EE). Units matter: mismatched units return receipt status UNITS_INCOMMENSURATE, not CONFLICT/DENY. A deal or loan outside coverage returns OUT_OF_COVERAGE.

tools.name: verify_appraised_value
tools.description: Verify issuance appraised value (Annex A vs ABS-EE). Date/basis mismatches return DATE_INCOMMENSURATE or BASIS_INCOMMENSURATE, not CONFLICT/DENY. A deal or loan outside coverage returns OUT_OF_COVERAGE.

tools.name: verify_counterparty
tools.description: Adjudicate 'who is the <role> on deal X' against the SEC 10-D counterparty roster (today: master and special servicer). A SINGLE-SOURCE roster fact. Master is the roster party, NOT the ABS-EE tape's primary servicer. Pass claimed_name: CONFIRM/DENY under the ledger's name normalization, never fuzzy.

tools.name: verify_loan_status_counts
tools.description: Verify count claims over loan status ('N in special servicing / paid off / defeased') for a deal. Counts are DERIVED from the ABS-EE tape, not reported by any filing. Three grains, never mixed: activity (active, resolved_paid_off, defeased); servicing: in_special_servicing = loans CURRENTLY with the

tools.name: verify_claims
tools.description: Bulk verifier: paste text, get per-claim statuses. ASSERTIONS ONLY: a QUESTION ('is it $9.4M?') binds nothing and returns total 0; single-value questions are not claims and are not checked here. Deterministic grammar, four families: loan fields, pool fields, servicer identity, loan-status counts. Un
